{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model BotW= [[File:BotW Ancient Set Model.png|320x320px]] |Model TotK= [[File:TotK Zonaite Set Model.png|320x320px]] }} |caption= |pronunciation= |game= BotW, TotK |other= |cost= |value= |location= |uses= |strength= |durability= |comp= |sample= |theme= }} '''Armor Sets''' are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}} {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Armor Set|Armor Sets|Series, BotW, TotK}} | {{List| * {{BotW}} * {{TotK}} }} }} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Armor Sets are matching collections of [[Armor]]. When worn, particular Armor Sets may confer additional effects known as [[Set Bonus]]es if every piece of Armor in that Set has been enhanced at least twice by a [[Great Fairy]]. As Armors introduced with {{TMT}} and {{TCB}} cannot be enhanced, the [[Royal Guard Set]] and [[Tingle's Outfit]] will provide their Set Bonuses when worn regardless. The [[Phantom Equipment]], [[Soldier's Set]], and [[Well-Worn Outfit]] lack any kind of Set Bonus. ====List of Armor Sets==== {{Gallery List|Items|fileType= Model |BotW= Ancient Set, Barbarian Set, Climbing Set, Dark Series, Desert Voe Set, Fierce Deity Set, Fireproof Armor, Gerudo Outfit, Hero of the Sky Set, Hero of the Wild Set, Hero of Time Set, Hero of Twilight Set, Hero of Winds Set, Hero Set, Hylian Armor Series, Phantom Equipment, Phantom Ganon Set, Radiant Set, Royal Guard Set, Rubber Armor (Set), Salvager Armor Set, Snowquill Set, Soldier's Set, Stealth Set, Tingle's Outfit, Well-Worn Outfit, Zora Set }} ====Additional Information==== {{Data Table |game= BotW |collapse= true |columns= Armor Set[Image:Model:150x150px][Link][Width:150px], Added Effect [Link][Nowrap], Set Bonuses [Link][Nowrap] |- | Ancient Set | Guardian Resist Up | Ancient Proficiency |- | Barbarian Set | Attack Up | Charge Atk.
